lyon-rh-ne-alpes-rides-dombes-lakes-easy.speedBand: 50–80 km/h riding core, local limits always win

sections.advice: Photo stop near Eyzin-Pinet → Scenic stretch near Mornant can flow quickly, but only if you keep village limits and junction sightlines sacred. Fast connectors are where rides get untidy when fatigue creeps in.

Scenic stretch near Mornant → Sorbiers, on the way back is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.

Food stop near Le Perréon → High point in Gleizé is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.

This High point in Gleizé → Chasselay stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

safetyMarkers.note: Respect posted limits and assume enforcement near villages, viewpoints and main-road joins.
